block.file_operations.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.file_operations.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.file_operations.model.title: File Operations
block.file_operations.model.description: Plan and explicitly approve bounded file copies, moves and quarantine without overwrites.
block.file_operations.help_allowed_root: Required existing boundary for all sources and targets. Blank disables planning and changes.
block.file_operations.help_allowed_opera: Allowed operations: copy, move, quarantine. Targets are never overwritten and parents must exist.
block.file_operations.help_plan_ttl_sec: Time allowed to approve a plan. Approval must match its exact digest and revision.
block.file_operations.help_max_operation: Maximum explicit operations per plan. No recursive folder operations or wildcards.
block.file_operations.help_max_plans: Maximum retained plans in this block's ledger; no automatic deletion.
block.file_operations.help_timeout_sec: Bounded planning or apply duration; a partial apply produces an explicit receipt.
